name: openapi-security-check
description: Map an OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 description to the OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023) risks, from the description only: operations without security, API keys in the query string, plain http servers, object identifiers, admin-looking paths, mass assignment, missing paging and limits, URL inputs and inventory problems, each with its JSON pointer. Fetches nothing, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
